predecessors.name: Jin dynasty (Western and Eastern Jin)
predecessors.text: Liang Province (central and western Gansu), where 'Zhang Gui was appointed as provincial inspector by the imperial court in 301'

successors.name: Former Qin
successors.text: Liang Province: 'In 376, Former Qin invaded, and Zhang Tianxi surrendered'

ledger.x: 301: Zhang Gui takes up Liang Province.
317: Zhang Shi makes Guzang (Wuwei) the capital; in 318 he keeps Emperor Min's Jianxing era instead of Sima Rui's.
329: the lands south of the Yellow River return.
329: Former Liang recovers the lands south of the Yellow River from the collapsing Former Zhao (see the 327 contest); the region is my reading of 'south of the Yellow River' inside the 324 outline.
335: Kucha and the oasis states submit.
ledger.cp: Kucha and the Western Regions oasis states

ledger.x: 346: Shi Hu takes the lands south of the Yellow River.
376: the tribute ends with the state.
ledger.cp: Kucha and the Western Regions oasis states

ledger.x: 376: as above, for Yanqi; the page is silent on the date.
26 September 376: Former Qin ends the Former Liang.

wars.name: Former Liang-Former Zhao war for the Yellow River lands
wars.outcome: Liu Yin took the Liang lands south of the Yellow River in 327; they returned to Former Liang in 329 when Former Zhao fell to Later Zhao.

wars.name: Battle between Former Liang and Later Zhao
wars.outcome: The Zhang Jun page mentions a battle in 344 without outcome or place; no border is recorded as moving.

wars.name: Former Qin conquest of Former Liang
wars.outcome: Former Qin invaded in 376 and Zhang Tianxi surrendered on 26 September, ending the state.

certainty.note: Provincial frontiers in the Hexi corridor and the Tarim edge; no page opened gives a treaty or survey line.
